proxy.name: infath-out-rjhi
proxy.description: infath-out-rjhi — Al Rajhi Bank (RJHI) B2B/VA services proxy. Client always sends/receives JSON; per-service conditional flows check a request body was provided, transform JSON<->XML for XML-only backend services, and route via a variable Path (CompletePathUrl) against a Target Server. Dev phase build — per-field validation is NOT implemented since the source Postman collection has no schema; add real required-field checks once the RJHI API spec is confirmed.

policies.xml:
